hypothesis: The unused NI PXI/MXI platform stack contributes to spontaneous S3 resume and may interact with resume instability.
single_material_variable: Removed the user-approved 22-package NI PXI/MXI dependency set through NI Package Manager; Wake Up Event By remained OS and no BIOS, chipset, power-policy, device, or other driver setting changed.
scope_caution: This isolates the NI PXI/MXI software stack and does not prove nipcibrd.sys alone is causal.

package_transaction.interpretation: All 22 removals completed; NI Package Manager then required a reboot to complete the transaction.

restart.failed_non_restart_invocation: An initial shutdown.exe invocation displayed usage and scheduled no restart.

post_removal_state.realtek: Up at 2.5 Gbps, fixed MAC matched, PnP OK/0, magic-packet wake enabled and wake-armed
post_removal_state.power_requests: Known post-boot USB Audio Device stream plus Legacy Kernel Caller pair; identical to the September 1 baseline condition, no Drive Optimizer or other maintenance request. No process was stopped because doing so would add a variable.

rollback_preservation.original_package_manager_cache_behavior: NI Package Manager purged the 22 package archives during removal.
rollback_preservation.recovery_action: Downloaded the exact registered 25.8 package builds into the diagnostic rollback directory without installing them.

cycle_health_common.wol_causal_evidence: resume began after WOL in all three cycles
cycle_health_common.pnp_interpretation: Nine devices enumerate after the immediate collector snapshot; the full 304-device inventory returns before the next cycle with all six xHCI controllers and all seven root hubs OK, so this is not persistent device loss.

confidence_update.spontaneous_wake: NI PXI/MXI stack involvement substantially strengthened, but formal 10-cycle qualification is required before identifying the root cause.
confidence_update.resume_corruption: No corruption reproduced in these three cycles. This does not yet identify whether the NI stack contributes to the independent intermittent processor-side xHCI resume failure.
